fieldContext.note: Desirable properties of individual requirements: Unambiguous, Testable, Binding, Atomic, Representative of true needs, Stakeholder vocabulary, Acceptable to all.
Desirable properties of overall requirements collection: Complete, Concise, Internally Consistent, Externally Consistent, Feasible.

personalNotes: The 5-whys technique prevents implementing premature, suboptimal solution requests instead of solving the true underlying problem.
